snippets.name: Alembic: autogenerate migration
snippets.description: Compares your SQLAlchemy models against the live DB and generates a new migration file. Replace 'description' with a short summary of what changed.

snippets.name: Alembic: upgrade to head
snippets.description: Applies all pending migrations to bring the database schema up to date.

snippets.name: Alembic: show current revision
snippets.description: Shows which migration revision the database is currently at.

snippets.name: Alembic: show migration history
snippets.description: Lists all migrations in order, showing which have been applied.

snippets.name: pytest: run with coverage
snippets.description: Runs all tests and prints a line-by-line coverage report for src/.

snippets.name: pytest: run one file
snippets.description: Runs a single test file. Replace the filename as needed.

snippets.name: run: train
snippets.description: Single-split training run. Trains for 20 epochs and saves model + eval artifacts to out/.

snippets.name: run: kfold
snippets.description: K-fold cross-validation (3 folds, 5 epochs each). Writes eval artifacts to out/.

snippets.name: run: predict
snippets.description: Run inference on tracks matching a regex. Replace the model path and filter as needed.

snippets.name: run: import rekordbox
snippets.description: Parses rekordbox.xml and upserts tracks, playlists, and markers into the database.

snippets.name: run: init db
snippets.description: Creates (or updates) the SQLite schema. Safe to re-run — only adds missing tables.
